checked_releases.addon_description: All-in-one native performance suite for Zotero: MuPDF 1.28.0 in-process PDF & thumbnail renderer (with dark/sepia LUT & HiDPI DPR cap), MuPDF full-text extraction & reader text layer, smart background tab hibernation, multi-threaded native file scanner & search cache, citation/CSL acceleration, SQLite tuning, and auto-WebP note image compression.

All-in-one native performance suite for Zotero: MuPDF 1.28.0 in-process PDF & async-encoded thumbnail renderer (with dark/sepia LUT, 120Hz frame pacing & HiDPI DPR cap), MuPDF full-text/Ctrl+F/outline/recognizer acceleration, smart background tab hibernation, multi-threaded native file scanner & search cache, citation/CSL acceleration, SQLite/FTS5 tuning, auto-WebP note image compression, and main UI selection coalescing & virtualized-list overscan.
